titulo.alumno:
«Длительность и завершённый срок»
Duration and a completed deadline

intro: За два часа can indicate the time taken to complete a task; два часа can express duration without stating a result.

piezas.titulo: За два часа can indicate the time taken to complete a task; два часа can express duration without stating a result.
texto: За два часа can indicate the time taken to complete a task; два часа can express duration without stating a result.
Distinguish the time spent from the total duration: читать два часа and прочитать за два часа.

frases.alumno: We spent two hours discussing the plan.
The team prepared the project in a week.

pregunta.texto: Which sentence presents a time needed to finish?

opciones.explicacion: За неделю delimits the time in which the project was completed.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Мы обсуждали план два часа.»

opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.
